citationText: 12. Paramount, Todd-AO, and Fox learned a lesson from Cinerama as well. Cinerama's failure to enter the conventional 35mm exhibition market seriously limited its profits (which were limited in the first place due to the enormous cost of theater conversion). Any expansion of the system necessitated that virtually all profits be plowed back into theater conversion, significantly reducing funds which the company might use to produce additional films.
